languageModel.argument: The sentence uses 'or' to connect two distinct paths: taking MATH 24005 OR taking MATH 24004. According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition, this represents a context where more than one alternative path is defined and any one path fulfills the parent condition, which maps to an 'any_of' node. The phrase ', each with a grade of C or higher.' applies to both alternatives within that 'or' group; since it is not separated by 'and' into two distinct requirements for a single course, but rather describes the condition for the selection made in the 'any_of' group, it is attached as a text item alongside the first course code under the 'any_of' parent. The definition of ceterms:requires confirms this structure represents the set of requirements where selecting either option satisfies the prerequisite.
